question: Draft an operations email for CHG-0034.
answer:
The draft recommends a physical inspection at Birmingham Motorway 006, on the basis that CHG-0034 reported 100% uptime with no faults or alerts while delivering nothing to drivers over the detected episode of 2 to 4 September 2026 (63 attempts, none successful, against 95.8% success on its site peers in the same window).

The single figure that justifies the dispatch is the estimated revenue at risk of GBP 1,151.24 over that three-day episode, at a current rate of GBP 383.75 per day, with the episode still running as of 4 September 2026. That is an estimate for operational prioritisation, not accounting-grade lost revenue.

Nothing has been sent and no ticket has been raised: the email and the P2 field maintenance ticket below are drafts and need a person to approve and send them.

metric_definitions.preparing_minutes: Plugged in but not yet charging. A unit that cannot deliver energy accumulates this without ever reaching Charging.
metric_definitions.alert_count: no description published in the semantic layer
metric_definitions.fault_count: no description published in the semantic layer
metric_definitions.zero_kwh_sessions: Attempts that transferred no energy at all, counted across every outcome category. Wider than the zero_energy outcome label, which is one category among several: a payment failure or an aborted session can also deliver nothing.
metric_definitions.failed_sessions: no description published in the semantic layer
metric_definitions.attempted_sessions: Every plug-in, whether or not energy flowed.

assumptions: Peer comparison uses the other chargers at the same station over the same window, so demand conditions are comparable.

Headline figures cover the ACTIVE EPISODE only. full_period_context covers the whole observed month. The contrast between them is what shows the unit was working before it stopped - do not present them as the same window.

evidence.timeline_note: Counts only status changes that began inside the window shown.
evidence.outcome_note: attempts_by_outcome splits the attempts by outcome label. The zero_energy row is one of those labels, not the total that delivered nothing: use metrics.zero_kwh_sessions for that, which also counts payment failures and aborted sessions that transferred no energy.

caveats: Absence of a fault or alert is evidence about the monitoring, not evidence that the charger is healthy.

Two counts here are close but not the same: failed_sessions is every attempt that did not succeed, zero_kwh_sessions is every attempt that delivered no energy. A session can fail having delivered a little energy, so the second is the smaller number. Quote whichever you mean and name it.
